response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong software engineering practices and the ability to architect complex projects, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. The position requires 8 years of C++ programming experience; the resume shows minimal C++ exposure (~6 months at National Instruments and a thesis project). Additionally, this mid-senior technical leadership role requires demonstrated experience mentoring and leading teams, which is absent from his background. His career trajectory has been a generalist full-stack path (TypeScript, Node.js, web/mobile) rather than specialization in cloud compute platforms and distributed infrastructure systems.
strengths: Proven ability to architect and complete large, ambiguous technical projects independently (GISCollective founder)
Strong commitment to software craftsmanship, testing methodologies (TDD), and establishing engineering best practices across organizations
Some relevant infrastructure and deployment experience including Docker, CI/CD systems, Kubernetes, and AWS CDK
concerns: Critical gap in C++ expertise: resume shows only ~6 months of C++ experience at National Instruments versus the 8-year requirement
No demonstrated formal technical leadership, team management, or structured mentoring experience despite mid-senior role level
Career shows full-stack generalist progression (TypeScript/Node.js focus) rather than specialization in cloud platforms, distributed systems, or infrastructure
